title: Segmentation Style Discovery: Application to Skin Lesion Images
mechanism: StyleSeg: M output heads plus a style classifier on (image, mask); winner-take-all Dice plus classifier-weighted Dice discovers M consistent styles without annotator IDs.
adaptation: M = 3 crack heads combined with source ID, to discover within-source annotator styles; after training pick each source's majority style head from train cells and use it at test.
min_experiment: Arm: source-FiLM + 3 style heads, 5 seeds vs source-FiLM arm alone; metric clean-49 crack IoU; kill if < +0.012 over the source-FiLM arm.
evidence: R: outperforms competing methods on four skin-lesion datasets; strong alignment of discovered styles with annotator preferences on ISIC-MultiAnnot.
